explanation: The legacy and Turboshaft revectorizers now take the load from the full splat index and use a lane-relative offset within its 128-bit input. The changed shared splat matcher reads past a 16-byte shuffle when top-tier Wasm compilation matches the last byte lane. After rebuilding the ASan d8 shell, the probe completed on the pinned parent and reported a stack-buffer-overflow on the edited tree. A separate 32-bit splat case reached revectorization and produced the expected bytes.
